statement: The set of Java-vs-RFC disagreements this plane has OBSERVED, each carrying the exact digest tuple the behavior-delta ledger binds, so lab.DetectUnledgeredDisagreements can match observation to record. This file is the input that makes evidence/java/behavior-delta-ledger.json's unledgered_disagreements field a real measurement instead of the hardcoded 0 it was until 2026-08-28: that field is now COMPUTED as the number of observations here whose disagreement digest has no record in the chain, the ledger schema admits any non-negative integer, and internal/lab VerifyBaselineEvidence refuses readiness when the count is nonzero. The file is COMMITTED and is never regenerated by the gate — only by an explicit `deltaledgerctl --regenerate-observations`. That is deliberate and is the whole source of the gate's polarity: because the observation outlives the removal of its record, deleting a ledger record makes the count rise and readiness refuse, which is exactly what the previous const-0 design could not do. Provenance entries are derived from the citations each definition already carries, so they cannot drift into a separate hand-maintained story. Every divergent row of evidence/us005-handshake-live-mapping.json must appear here, which binds the set to evidence on its other side.
